name: muffet-5ccb618f-blind24-ots
instr:
# muffet: a site crawler that passes broken links and fails healthy ones, without a test suite

The repository has received 24 separate undocumented edits.

This tool is aimed at a web address, retrieves the document sitting there, follows every reference it turns up, and says whether anything it reached was dead. It now has all of that wrong, from one end to the other. Nothing about the network changed and nothing about the sites being audited changed: the same invocations that used to be answered correctly are now answered wrongly, healthy sites are condemned, and dead references slip by unremarked.

Starting the tool and watching how it ends. A starting address that is retrieved without trouble now makes the whole crawl finish as a failure, while a starting address whose first retrieval fails no longer finishes with the report it used to emit. Separately, every genuine failure has gone quiet: supplying no address at all, a host that refuses connections, a starting address that answers with an image body instead of markup, or asking for both the verbose listing and the tag-based report at once all still finish with a non-zero exit, but nothing whatsoever reaches the stream reserved for diagnostics.

Judging an individual reply. With the usual accepted band, a reply numbered exactly 200 is refused as unacceptable, while 201 and the values up to just under the top of the band still pass and the top value itself is still refused. Asking for one single number to be accepted qui
